messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT — service=infra.inference-gateway region=us-west2 metric=5xx_rate threshold=5% current=9.8% — page: PDRm8x3 

oncall-ryan: acked. pulling up dashboards. :eyes:
sre-anya: seeing same, spike started ~2m ago. high 502s from backend pool A.
eng-runtime: noticed recent deploy to routing-proxy 02:15 UTC, rolling back?
oncall-ryan: hold on, running quick check: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=inference-gateway -o wide`
ops-maya: I can warm up an alternate pool in eu-west1 for critical traffic if needed.
sre-anya: logs show upstream timeout + 502s, KV-cache evictions spiking. attaching runbook snippet: 
```
Runbook: inference-gateway-5xx
1) Check pool A pods, restart failing containers
2) Disable canary routing to proxy-02
3) Reroute traffic to pool B / eu-west1 as fallback
```
eng-runtime: rolling proxy-02 back now (start rollback command). ETA ~90s.
oncall-ryan: PD escalation config — next escalation in 4m if unacked by L2. I have team on standby.
pd-bot: Note: PagerDuty will escalate to SRE Lead if alert persists >5m.
sre-anya: rollback complete. proxy-02 pod count back to healthy. 502 rate dropping to 6.1%.
oncall-ryan: good. keep monitoring. Maya, start eu-west1 warmup but don't flip yet.
ops-maya: warming pool B, warming embeddings cache. prep for drain of pool A.
eng-runtime: adding a short traffic-weight change: route 80%->pool B 20%->A for 30s to observe.
sre-anya: 5xx down to 3.4% (1m). KV-cache misses trending down after warmup.
oncall-ryan: thumbs. notifying support to check customer-facing error pages.
ops-maya: support notified. posting customer-impact summary: small fraction of requests (~0.7%) got 502s for ~3m window, mostly from long-tail requests.
eng-runtime: creating postmortem stub in #incidents-pm and pinging for logs. link: https://internal.redwood/pm/1769997771
sre-anya: marking alert as mitigated in PD. will follow up with RCA.
oncall-ryan: handing off to SRE Anya for investigation. I'm off the page, keeping watch. :white_check_mark:
sre-anya: taking handoff. collecting full traces and recent deploy diff. will update in 30m. :mag_right:
incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring (owner: sre-anya).
